canada.summary: Weeks after officials in Nunavut issued a boil water advisory for Baker Lake, that advisory was lifted.

canada.title: First Nations in B.C. challenge Carney's Pacific Link pipeline national interest designation
canada.summary: Several First Nations in B.C. are challenging the federal government in court and seeking to overturn its decision to designate the Pacific Link pipeline project as a project of national interest.

canada.title: Mother dead, daughter missing in suspected grizzly bear attack in Bella Coola
canada.summary: A mother is dead and her 19-year-old daughter is missing after a suspected grizzly bear attack in Bella Coola, B.C.

canada.title: AFN chief says no one besides Carney, Kinew talked about abolishing Indian Act
canada.summary: OTTAWA - The national chief of the Assembly of First Nations says the only leaders to discuss abolishing the Indian Act during a landmark meeting last week were Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew and Prime Minister Mark Carney.

canada.title: N.L. introduces civil forfeiture legislation to seize property linked to crime
canada.summary: The government of Newfoundland and Labrador has brought forward legislation that could allow the seizure of assets linked to criminal activity, even if a person isn't convicted of any crime.

canada.title: Nearly 2-month-old strike at Selkirk steel recycling plant could head to arbitration
canada.summary: Roughly 80 workers at a Selkirk, Man., recycling plant started striking Sept. 11, after negotiations for a new collective agreement faltered. If no deal is reached by next week, either party could apply for arbitration.

canada.title: Alberta teen accused of terrorism offences connected to ISIS
canada.summary: A teenager in Alberta has been arrested and charged with engaging in terrorism-related offences, after police said they were talking online with people affiliated with ISIS.

canada.title: ‘Mining-induced event’ suspected cause of Saskatchewan tremor: Earthquakes Canada
canada.summary: Esterhazy, Sask., was awoken by seismic activity Tuesday morning after a suspected mining-induced event triggered a tremor, Earthquakes Canada said.

canada.title: Contractor sues N.L. government over cancelled Cartwright school, Martin Gallant Building contracts
canada.summary: The province of Newfoundland and Labrador is being sued for damages by JMJ Holdings after cancelling two contracts earlier this year.

canada.title: Former officer accused in 3 sexual assault cases no longer employed by RCMP
canada.summary: The third case of sexual assault involving a former RCMP constable was dismissed on Monday after the Crown brought no evidence. The RCMP said Tuesday William McNutt, 41, is now no longer an employee.

canada.title: 3.4 magnitude earthquake near Esterhazy, Sask., likely caused by mining, Natural Resources Canada says
canada.summary: The earthquake — measured at a 3.4 magnitude — struck at 7:04 a.m. CST. Its epicentre was about nine kilometres east-northeast of Esterhazy, according to the NRC's Earthquake Canada website.

canada.title: 'Serious issue': family lawyer shortage forcing self-representation in Yukon courts
canada.summary: Yukoners don’t have sufficient access to lawyers generally, with 99 per cent of them concentrated in Whitehorse, states a 2024 report from the society. Still, the greatest demand for lawyers is in family law, followed by civil litigation, real estate, and wills and estates.

canada.title: Foodtastic makes takeover offer for MTY Food Group; MTY replaces CEO
canada.summary: Foodtastic's latest pitch comes two weeks after it said MTY rebuffed a prior takeover attempt. MTY launched a strategic review in 2025 after its stock faced pressure for rising prices, competition and economic volatility.

canada.title: Toronto police investigating second report of pins found in Halloween candy
canada.summary: The update expands on an investigation after a Toronto family discovered sewing needles and pins embedded in Halloween treats.

canada.title: Hydro-Québec projects deficit that could force it to rely on U.S. and other provinces
canada.summary: Hydro-Québec has released a report suggesting it may need to import electricity from neighbouring provinces or the United States within the next three years.

canada.title: 17-year-old Alberta youth arrested on terrorism-related offence
canada.summary: A 17-year-old from Alberta has been arrested for a terrorism-related offence after allegedly corresponding with online accounts associated with ISIS.

canada.title: Road worker dead after being struck by dump truck in Pickering: police
canada.summary: A road worker has died after being struck by a dump truck in Pickering, Ont., Monday, Durham police say.

canada.title: Rally held in Pugwash to support survivor of intimate partner violence
canada.summary: People packed a community hall in Pugwash, N.S., on Sunday to show support for a woman who was viciously attacked by her former partner.

lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

King Charles III called the transatlantic slave trade a “shameful chapter of history” during a speech Tuesday at the official opening of the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Antigua, The Associated Press reports.

The Bloc Québécois is making a budget request calling on Mark Carney’s government to double its benefit designed to help households cope with higher-than-ever prices on grocery store shelves, The Canadian Press reports.

Voters struggling with high prices and angry over the Iran war will decide Tuesday whether to drastically shift power in Washington in midterm elections that will serve as a referendum on President Donald Trump’s second term, The Associated Press reports.

Jacob Morley, 28, escaped from the Northwest Correctional Complex in Tennessee’s far northwestern corner on Oct. 25, after he slipped through a fence in his prison clothes, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
